harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured and verified daily rotation of /var/log/inventory/app.log with seven compressed rotations and copy-truncate writer continuity. RHEL 10.0 and kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0 remain unchanged. node1 was safely restarted and fully recovered.
actions_performed: Installed /etc/logrotate.d/inventory with daily, rotate 7, compress, missingok, notifempty, and copytruncate.
Validated configuration syntax and performed a live rotation while a writer retained its open file descriptor.
Observed the stock daily systemd timer trigger and complete successfully.
Restarted node1 safely and verified changed boot identity, persistent configuration, intact data, active services, enforcing SELinux, and zero failed units.
Removed temporary test state and confirmed no test writer or reboot units remained.

evidence.requirement: Daily rotation with seven compressed rotations
evidence.summary: The validated and persisted rule specifies daily, rotate 7, and compress. The stock daily timer completed successfully and remains enabled and active.
A live writer remained running with the same open descriptor and inode across rotation, wrote new records afterward, and the resulting gzip archive passed integrity and content-preservation checks.

evidence.requirement: Preserve installed OS release, kernel, security, access, and data
evidence.summary: Before/after evidence shows unchanged RHEL 10.0, kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0, configuration and data checksums, enforcing SELinux, active SSH, and no failed units.

Healthy baseline boot ID 2db46909-a020-4fda-b1db-2c3ead04c18a was captured, reboot acknowledged, disconnect observed, and recovery proved with new boot ID e10d5f33-da41-41b9-a71f-c429618ecb28 plus healthy services and intact data.
Temporary state, test writer, and transient reboot units are absent; archive integrity passes, retention count is within seven, required services are active, and no failed units remain.
